review_text: I love this place to Dine-in, eventhough it's quiet a distance from the downtown area... Their Food are delicious.. It's a beautiful old Residential house converted to a Restaurant.. That's why they named it "DAKONG BALAY" means a "BIG HOUSE"....

We had a wonderful lunch today in Dakong Balay. The ancestral house is relaxing and historic. We booked one of their private rooms, and the service was smooth. Staff were all attentive. Everything is so delicious. The place is massive, and it's perfect for all occasions. They have lovely gardens and big fish tanks. My family and our guests are beyond satisfied. 😊 Thank you!

Though I haven't visited the place in person, but I used to order food from them via Grab. The pork humba is so delicious and their chopsuey. Hindi basta-basta, fresh and hindi tipid 👌. You can tell that they know what they're doing. Kudos!
Perfect place to dine in with your family and friends.🥰 The ambiance of the place feels like home.🤗 They have a sumptuous food 😋and better service.

It was father's day and we decided to celebrate the event here. The main house was closed or perhaps only early reserved people were able to dine there. Thus we made it to the big tent, al fresco like set up. The price of food is acceptable since it was a buffet and it was a real taste of home. Though they only have limited options and mostly not suggested for a vegetarian. And if they are on a specific menu (like buffet) they don't do special orders as they are focused on what is available. Lots of parking, they have a huge area, but going here from the main road is a long narrow street and might confuse you as it is near to the fish port but yes you are at the right way. Since we are from downtown of Davao, I don't really recommend driving all the way here just to eat buffet but rather try their ala carte meals and drinks.

The place is early far away from the main road but the place has a homey atmosphere to it. Their food is affordable and delicious. There are multiple fish aquariums outside and also there is a children's playground. This is a nice place for parties and other functions.

toril best keep secret restaurant. one of family favourite lunch after sunday mass 🙏🏻 The staff even remembers our usual orders — it feels like a second home. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a welcoming spot with great food and even better vibes! outdoor and indoor table is available

To get here was a long way with narrow roads and tricycles speeding up to get past vehicles like mine. But I heaved a sigh of relief upon reaching the place. The ground area was huge. Playground, parking space, open-air seating and a tent for functions and don’t forget the enclosed dining inside the house itself. Vast expanse to roam and walk around. Low prices for plates that can be shared by 2-3 people. Filipino cuisine that are old-time staples in households and restaurants alike are found here and so much more. Chopseuy chicken, kare-kare (pork), and beef salpicao were what we sampled early at 5pm. All went well with staff service and accommodation. Place reminds me of my grandparents’ old house during the 1900s of dark wood and sliding windows made of CAPIZ SHELLS. Interior was updated to match our modern time but still retains a touch of ancestral allure. Till the next drive….

I only capture places that I find beautiful and worth showcasing. I never expected to love this restaurant so much that I had to include it in my travel videos. The atmosphere is cozy, the food is absolutely delicious, and the service is exceptional! I’d love to celebrate special occasions here, and I wouldn’t mind making the trip to Toril for a place like this. Absolutely one of my top recommended restaurants in Davao! 💯
Loved the ambiance. I ordered their tuna sandwich and to my surprise the serving was big. Hindi rin tinipid yung ingredients.

Food was really comforting, and delicious. Coffee is absolutely my favorite - great quality. Everyone was accommodating and the atmosphere was so relaxing. Must-try Coffeehouse & Restaurant in Toril, Davao City!

Was able to try this new resto/cafe because we had a business meeting with my boss. So the private area for meetings at the second floor was given to us. The food was great, we ordered kinilaw, cauliflower and broccoli, lapu lapu, pancit canton, pork binagoongan, crispy maskara, americano, mango and avocado shake and other food and beverages. The serving and pricing are okay. The staff were great and the place is nice. An old ancestral house converted into a restaurant and cafe. I guess the place looks and feels nice during the evening. Ample parking space and the location is along the main road. The neighborhood is actually the typical Daliao near fish port kind of thing. The only thing not nice is the AC of the meeting/conference room as it was not able to cool the area due to the wall and division design. Other than that, the rest were good. Will try to go back here for a casual coffee and food rendezvous.
The place actually feels homey. The taste of the food is good that panders to the Filipino taste and the portions are decent and tasteful.
Very friendly staff. Even the owners are very accommodating. Good food, nice ambiance, instagrammable ang place and nice and comfort room. Malacañang feels. 😁 Highly recommended 💯

I had the pleasure of dining at Dakong Balay today because I was invited to a birthday celebration, and I must say, it was an unforgettable experience. From the moment I stepped inside, I was captivated by the restaurant's inviting atmosphere and charming interior. With its combination of rustic decor and modern touches, Dakong Balay exudes a cozy and welcoming ambiance that instantly puts you at ease. Dakong Balay boasts an extensive menu filled with mouthwatering options, but two dishes, in particular, stole the show for me: the pork spareribs and the pork humba. Aside from these standout dishes, Dakong Balay offers a range of other delectable options to satisfy any craving. (I was not able to take pictures of the food since we couldn't resist digging right away. lol) Furthermore, as a coffee aficionado, I am eagerly anticipating my next visit to Dakong Balay to explore their impressive coffee options. In addition to the remarkable food and beverage offerings, the service at Dakong Balay is top-notch. The staff members are attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable, going above and beyond to ensure a memorable dining experience. I wholeheartedly recommend this place 🫶

No initiative from their waiters as well to check up on us, if we needed plates and utensils bussed out since masikip na nga sa table. Worst, walang waiter man lang dedicated to us na nakastandby sa private room, given na we are a large group and is hosting a large celebration. I get it na it’s weekend and they’re full pero that’s not an excuse para di nila maasikaso ng maayos. Graduation dinner for my family got ruined, thanks Dakong Balay.

Still a top homey place restaurant in Toril Davao City. Food is nice and relaxed atmosphere. At night its beautiful too and this is very popular in Toril for families coming to eat good food. Price is ok too affordable. We've been here so many times each time we come for holiday in Toril. Maybe more than 10 times family had a meal here big chow we just had 5 times in 2024 6 times in 2025 and 1 in 2026 before as well 2023 maybe 6 times too. The location the locals knows even the taxis of drivers from Toril. But I'd ask the locals in Daliao. Dakong balay means big house. It's an old designed house located in Daliao Toril DC like an uncestral home very Filipino which they turned into a homey Filipino restaurant. Great traditional food only that sometimes it's too sweet eg Chopsuey not all the time but most of the time. Come visit the place.
